label: login-app.vercel.app

label: flydubai-payment-verification-psi.vercel.app
title: flydubai | Confirm Payment
reasons: The page impersonates flydubai with a fake booking (EM3LFP) and presents a form collecting full credit card details: card number, expiry, CVV, and cardholder name.
